title: AutomotiveTelemetryLegalDefense
description: Schema for sovereign pro se legal claims against automotive OEMs and data brokers for surreptitious telemetry exfiltration and statutory privacy violations (CIPA/CCPA/CPRA).

oem_identifier.description: Automotive OEM targeted by the claim.

data_broker_recipient.description: Third-party data broker or InsurTech underwriter receiving raw telemetry.

wiretap_violation_count.description: Number of discrete surreptitious kinetic packet exfiltrations detected.

statutory_damages_per_violation.description: Statutory damage floor per violation under California Invasion of Privacy Act / CCPA.

counterparty_defense_hourly_rate.description: Estimated billable rate of defense counsel per hour.
